\usepackage{soul}
\definecolor{Sun}{RGB}{255,232,128}
\definecolor{Sky}{RGB}{184,214,255}
\newcommand{\hlsun}[1]{{\sethlcolor{Sun}\hl{#1}}}
\newcommand{\hlsky}[1]{{\sethlcolor{Sky}\hl{#1}}}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}

On the far bank the miller kept a small \hlsun{water}\hlsky{wheel} turning all winter, and the whole village relied on it for flour.

Each morning a \hlsun{fore}cast was pinned to the door of the inn; the bak\hlsky{er}y opened at six, and the ferry\hlsun{man} waited for the bell.

The old road ran along the valley, and \hlsky{the travellers who walked it in the evening could see the lights of three towns spread along the river far below them} before the path turned north into the hills.

Nobody in the village remembered who first called it the \hl{lantern} path, nor why the name had stayed.
